verdict.rationale: Angular ships extensive official first-party packages, CLI, and documented APIs (angular-docs-3, angular-docs-9–20) that developers can build directly against, and claims 'AI-forward resources and integrations' (angular-docs-4), but there is no concrete evidence of a dedicated AI-specific SDK, multi-language bindings, or agent-focused API surface beyond a vague marketing line. missing for 10: concrete AI-specific SDK/tooling details, independent corroboration of the 'AI-forward' claim, evidence of agent-oriented API design.
